model.name: tusar2023-catl-ph5.5-observed
model.assay: Purified cathepsin L, protected synthetic peptides, pH 5.5, 37 C, 2 h
model.limitations: Two selected source substrates (p3/p4) only. Exact sequence/terminal-chemistry lookup; no novel-sequence inference, negative site labels, pH transfer, peptide survival or APC presentation calibration.

conditions.buffer: 30 mM NaOAc, 30 mM NaCl, 5 mM DTT
conditions.substrate_concentration: Empirically chosen per peptide; numeric concentrations not reported
conditions.enzyme_preparation: Purified active cathepsin L; no activation protocol specified for this peptide assay
conditions.readout: RP-HPLC separation followed by MALDI-TOF product identification
conditions.inhibitors: No inhibitor reported for the peptide cleavage assay
conditions.accessibility: Soluble synthetic peptide with N-acetylated and C-amidated termini
conditions.detection_limit: Not reported; unreported bonds are unknown

cases.source_measurement_id: Supplementary Data 4 page 1, CatL p3; Supplementary Tables 3 and 17
cases.interpretation: Internal boundaries of experimentally identified products; retained parent termini are not cleavage events
